name: Rare Michigan | Cadbury OG
description: Cadbury OG is as smooth as the finest chocolate from Belgium and packing a punch like no other. Cadbury's hard, keefy buds will lift you into its savory, smokey taste. A high that starts in the brain and travels all around your body, this hybrid strain is perfect for all your high activities!
